subject: PO recipient routing, invoice cutoff window & pre-invoice approval - Medsys
messages:
From: Laurent Dupont <laurent@medsys.co>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medsys.co
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 09:16:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood PO requirements + invoice cadence question

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Medsys leadership liked the performance numbers and the routing options. Procurement is ready to move forward but we need a couple of procurement-side confirmations before issuing a Purchase Order. Can you confirm the following?

1) PO recipient / remit-to: Our accounting system requires invoices to be addressed to a specific remit code and PO receiver name. Will Redwood accept invoices addressed to a departmental remit ("Medsys Cloud Services - Remit 4321") rather than a person?

2) Invoice cadence & cutoff: We run a monthly pay cycle that requires invoices to be submitted by the 3rd business day of the following month for payment on net-30 terms. Can Redwood support that cadence (monthly consolidated invoice) and provide a single invoice referencing a single PO number?

3) Pre-invoice approval: For security/compliance we need 72 hours to review invoices before they hit our ERP (to reconcile usage and tags). Is it possible to get a draft invoice or usage report 3 business days prior to invoice issuance for approval?

I've attached our standard PO template (for your reference). Procurement and AP are cc'd on this thread — please loop in finance if needed.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can finalize internal approvals.

Best,
Laurent Dupont
Director, Strategic Sourcing
Medsys Health

Attachment: Medsys_PO_Template.xlsx (spreadsheet - PO fields)

From: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Laurent Dupont <laurent@medsys.co>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, procurement@medsys.co
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood PO requirements + invoice cadence question

Hi Laurent — thanks for the clear list. Short answers below and a couple of notes.

1) PO recipient / remit-to: Yes — we accept remit-to departmental addresses. Invoices can be issued to "Medsys Cloud Services - Remit 4321" as long as the PO number and remit code are present in the invoice header. We will also include a billing reference line for your ERP code if you provide it (please confirm field name/format).

2) Invoice cadence & cutoff: We can do a consolidated monthly invoice per PO with a submission cutoff of the 3rd business day. Our standard hosted terms are net-30 from invoice date; if you need net-30 from month-end we can accommodate but would like to confirm with Finance (cc'd: Ben).

3) Pre-invoice approval: We can provide a draft usage report 72 hours prior to invoice issuance. We usually export a CSV with route-level line items and token counts. If you prefer a PDF summary, we can include both.

I'll attach the draft SOW and a short checklist for PO fields that our billing system requires. Ben — can you confirm the net-30-from-invoice vs net-30-from-month-end nuance and whether Redwood is able to accept "net-30 from month-end" for this enterprise PO?

Next steps: if Medsys confirms remit-code field name and accepts our standard SOW and billing field list, we can issue a proforma invoice for October usage for your 72-hour review.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v3.pdf (PDF)

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Laurent Dupont <laurent@medsys.co>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@medsys.co
Date: Wed, 06 Oct 2026 11:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood PO requirements + invoice cadence question

Jasmine / Laurent — quick finance confirmation.

We can accept net-30 from invoice date by default. Net-30 from month-end is acceptable for deals with a booked ARR > $150k/year; otherwise we need to keep net-30 from invoice date. For DEAL-8421 (as discussed with Sales) we can approve net-30 from month-end provided Medsys commits to the monthly consolidated invoice and the PO references the deal ID (DEAL-8421) and the remit code.

On remit fields: please include an "ERP Remit Code" field (alphanumeric, up to 12 chars) in the PO. That will map cleanly into our billing system. For the pre-invoice window we will provide a draft CSV report 3 business days prior. The draft will include: route name, model variant, token counts, unit rate, line total. If you need additional tags (cost center, project code) include them in the PO and we'll reflect them on the invoice.

If Medsys needs an earlier payment date or extended terms beyond net-30, we'll need a Finance review and an approval from Revenue Ops.

Ben Carter
Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

[Internal note] Marissa — please prepare a proforma for October referencing DEAL-8421 once Laurent confirms the ERP remit code format.

From: Laurent Dupont <laurent@medsys.co>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medsys.co, Medsys Health Accounts Payable <ap@medsys.co>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood PO requirements + invoice cadence question

Jasmine / Ben / Marissa — thanks for the clarifications. Medsys confirms the following and we are prepared to issue the PO this week: 

• PO remit-to: "Medsys Cloud Services - Remit 4321" — ERP Remit Code = "MSY-4321" (alphanumeric, 7 chars).
• Invoice cadence: consolidated monthly invoice per PO. Invoice will be payable net-30 from month-end (approved).
• Pre-invoice approval: please send draft CSV 3 business days prior to invoice date to ap@medsys.co (CC procurement@medsys.co). Medsys AP will reply with any tag adjustments within 48 hours.

We will attach the PO when sending to you — please confirm the single PO number can be referenced across all monthly invoices and that Redwood will include the ERP Remit Code field on the invoice header. Also, Redwood: can you include our internal cost-center as an invoice line tag ("project_code") when present? That is required for our internal allocation.

Once you confirm those last points we'll route the PO and execute.

Best regards,
Laurent Dupont
Director, Strategic Sourcing
Medsys Health

Attachment: Medsys_PO_8421.pdf (PDF stub - PO)
